PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
No. 2005/4 – MONDAY, FEBRUARY 06, 2017
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: 6/3/7/15/5/7. Ref. No. of Min. of Lands : LD/05/2007/MV/110G.

I, here give notice that the government intends to acquire the following land that necessary for a public purpose under sub-section (i) of section (7) of land Acquisition Act which was amended as per the amended Land Acquisition Act, No. 28 of 1964.
Description of the Land to be aquired: Acquiring of land for development project of Moragahakanda and Kaluganga is denoted as a public purpose in this effort.

Details of Allotment of lands shown in Surveyor Generals’ approved Plan No. F. V. P. 89, supplement 34, sheet 89, dated 30.12.2016 situated in Thalagoda village (Part) in the Thalagoda GN Division, in Wagapanaha Pallesiyapattu, in Naula DS division, Matale District of Central Province are as follows.
1. Lot No. 3730 Name of the Land: Kumbukgollayaya; Decription: Garden; Claimant: possessed by Mr. Kamburupitiya Arachchige Lal Dasanayake of Thalagoda, Thalagoda Junction; Extent: 0.1127 Hectare.

2. Lot No. 3731 Name of the Land: Kumbukgollayaya; Decription: Chena; Claimant: State, possessed by Mr. Kamburupitiya Arachchige Lal Dasanayake of Thalagoda, Thalagoda Junction without permission; Extent: 0.0146 Hectare.

3. Lot No. 3733 Name of the Land: Kumbukgollayaya; Decription: Shrub Jungle; Claimant: State, possessed by Mrs. Gamaralalage Gedara Yasho Menike, Thalagoda, Thalagoda Junction without permission; Extent: 0.3343 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents before me at 9.00 a.m. on the 29th day of March 2017, at the Naula Divisional Secretariat.

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Ref. No.: 6/3/7/15/5/7. Ref. No. of Min. of Lands : LD/05/2007/MV/110G.

I hereby give notice that the Government intends to acquire the following land that necessary for a public purpose under Sub-section (i) of section (7) of Land Acquisition Act which was amended as per the amended Land Acquisition Act, No. 28 of 1964.
Description of the Land to be acquired: Acquiring of land for development project of Moragahakanda and Kaluganga is denoted as a public purpose in this effort.

Details of Allotment of lands shown in Surveyor General’s approved plan No. F. V. P. 535, Supplement 15, Sheet 12, dated 30.12.2016 situated in Thalagoda Village (part) in the Thalagoda GN division, in Gangala Pallesiyapattu, in Naula DS Division, Matale district of Central Province are as follows:

1. Lot No. 1192 Name of the Land: Karavilakanaththa; Decription: Garden; Claimant: State; possessed by Mr. Rangana Dissanayakelage Gamini Dissanayake of Thalagoda, Thalagoda Junction; Extent: 0.0463 Hectare.

D. R. B. N. B. KARUNATHILAKE, Divisional Secretary, Naula. At Divisional Secretary’s Office, Naula, 02nd February, 2017. 02-824/2
